dct_creator_sm: Huffman, Jesse (Department of Food Science. Ontario Agricultural College. University of Guelph.).
dct_description_sm: This data represents the data used in the Fermentation article "Contamination of maize silage with Bacillus and Clostridium spores and effects on the fermentation and microbial community, with or without inoculation by Lentilactobacillus buchneri NCIMB 40788". It contains raw fastq files (16S and ITS1 community sequencing), physicochemical profiles, NMR data, and metadata for all silage samples.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Contamination of maize silage with Bacillus and Clostridium spores and effects on the fermentation and microbial community, with or without inoculation by Lentilactobacillus buchneri NCIMB 40788
